scope: Conditional owner-local native MOVE corridor through an existing finite recovery parent
sourceIntent: HBQ navigation-area intent integrated into the existing CBE lead-vehicle controller, not a second controller or a whole-HBQ parity claim. The protected reference sources were not modified.
changes: Native corridor admission requires current REFRESH/FINAL DESTINATION recovery parent, matching route/seats and original unexpired hard deadline/progress anchor. It cannot fabricate a waypoint or create a new recovery episode.

Corridor and static bypass share the existing bypassSpent alternate-path allowance. Approach/crossing deadlines are capped by the original parent hard deadline; capture/return cannot replenish the budget.

Route-reader-free CORRIDOR command classification retains parent identity during APPROACH/CROSS, including expired exact commands for cleanup only. Approach protects original/entry driver destination and exact commander receipt; crossing protects both destinations and task eligibility. Simultaneous conflicting child work refuses.

The existing driving callback recognizes CORRIDOR as child retention, blocks competing ordinary parent recovery and preserves the spent parent across corridor/traffic waits. No new FSM/PFH/timer/world query.

Native return observes both owned STOP tasks and unchanged original parent/child, then issues the original goal once through the existing two-second request journal capped by parent expiry. The shared bypassReturn marker carries a CORRIDOR-tagged context and uses the existing both-seat MOVE ACK classifier.

Shutdown retires a matching native corridor before its recovery parent. Expired/mismatched parent cannot authorize onward motion; exact expired-parent stop-only cleanup still checks old command ownership. Successor episode identity is rechecked before final metadata retirement.

validation.failureDisposition: Initial failures were three old BYPASS-only/native-corridor-exclusion source contracts. After extending them, one further BYPASS-only exact string was corrected. Original cap/route/expiry guards remain asserted.

validation.limits: Static contracts/models do not execute SQF. Physical normal/provider-HC passage, native STOP/return timing, collisions, same-value replacement, replication and frame-time cost remain unverified. Audits paused; no Arma launch.

remaining: Native corridors still defer without a live REFRESH/FINAL parent. This is not unconditional native-route parity.
Passing and automatic multi-owner queue recovery still reject native routes.
Native child locality adoption and immediate STOP/two-seat ACK behaviour are not physically established; no synthetic ACK, forced completion or replay is added.
Production goal, tactical efficacy and 5% median/10% p95 budget remain incomplete.
